business_summary: Watts Water Technologies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, supplies products and solutions that manage and conserve the flow of fluids and energy into, through, and out of buildings in the commercial, industrial, and residential markets. The company offers residential and commercial flow control and protection products, including backflow preventers, water pressure regulators, temperature and pressure relief valves, thermostatic mixing valves, leak detection and protection products, commercial washroom solutions, hydration solutions, and emergency safety products and equipment for plumbing and hot water applications. It also provides heating, ventilation, and air conditioning and gas products comprising commercial, institutional, and industrial boilers; water heaters and heating solutions; hydronic and electric heating systems for under-floor radiant applications; custom heat and hot water solutions; hydronic pump groups for boiler manufacturers and alternative energy control packages; and flexible stainless-steel connectors for natural and liquid propane gas in commercial food service and residential applications. In addition, the company offers drainage and water re-use products, such as drainage products, engineered rainwater harvesting solutions for commercial, industrial, marine, and residential applications; connected roof drain systems; and water quality products, including point-of-use and point-of-entry, closed loop, cooling tower, and other water applications for commercial, marine, and residential applications. It sells its products to plumbing, heating, and mechanical wholesale distributors and dealers; original equipment manufacturers; specialty product distributors; and do-it-yourself and retail chains, as well as wholesalers and private label accounts in the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, and Africa. Watts Water Technologies, Inc. was founded in 1874 and is headquartered in North Andover, Massachusetts.
business_summary_ko: Watts Water Technologies, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 상업, 산업 및 주거 시장에서 건물 안팎으로 유체와 에너지의 흐름을 관리하고 보존하는 제품과 솔루션을 공급합니다. 이 회사는 역류 방지기, 수압 조절기, 온도 및 압력 릴리프 밸브, 온도 조절 혼합 밸브, 누출 감지 및 보호 제품, 상업용 화장실 솔루션, 수화 솔루션, 비상 안전 제품 및 배관 및 온수 응용 장비를 포함한 주거용 및 상업용 흐름 제어 및 보호 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 상업용, 기관용 및 산업용 보일러로 구성된 난방, 환기, 냉방 및 가스 제품을 제공합니다. 온수기 및 난방 솔루션; 바닥 복사 적용을 위한 순환수 및 전기 난방 시스템; 맞춤형 열 및 온수 솔루션; 보일러 제조업체 및 대체 에너지 제어 패키지를 위한 순환수 펌프 그룹; 상업용 식품 서비스 및 주거용 응용 분야의 천연 및 액체 프로판 가스를 위한 유연한 스테인리스 스틸 커넥터입니다. 또한 회사는 배수 및 물 재사용 제품을 제공합니다.
